meaning.vi: Một người được tuyển dụng để sắp xếp.

sentences.en: Owing to the comnaratively small amount of letters, it is found possible to have a travelling post office on all principal trains (while almost every train has a travelling sorter, for whom a compartment is reserved) without a late fee being exacted in either case.
